name: Lying Cable Pullover
cues: Lie on a flat bench with the head toward the stack and the pulley at its lowest;Arms stay nearly straight and sweep from overhead to the thighs

name: Standing Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
cues: Pulley high, hinge slightly at the hips;Push the handles down to the thighs with straight arms

name: Cable Lat Prayer
cues: Kneel facing the high pulley with a straight bar;Sit the hips back and press the bar toward the floor with straight arms

name: Cable Single-Arm High Row
cues: Pulley at head height, step back and brace;Pull the elbow to the ribs, finish with the hand beside the chest

name: Cable Archer Row
cues: Pulleys at chest height with strap or D handles;Pull one arm in while the other arm stays extended out to the side

name: Cable Squat to Row
cues: Pulley at about knee height, hold the handle at arm's length;Squat down, then stand and row the handle to the ribs in one flow

name: Cable Squat to Press
cues: Pulleys low with strap handles at the shoulders;Squat down, then stand and press overhead

name: Cable Goblet Squat
cues: Hold a V handle at the chest, pulley at its lowest;Squat down between the hips with the chest tall

name: Cable Deadlift
cues: Pulley at its lowest with a straight bar;Hinge, grip the bar, then stand tall by driving the hips forward

name: Cable Sumo Deadlift
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out, V handle between the feet;Push the floor away and stand tall

name: Cable Split Squat
cues: Hold a D handle or V handle at the chest, pulley low;Lower the back knee toward the floor, front shin near vertical

name: Cable Incline Bench Curl
cues: Set an adjustable bench to about 45 degrees with the low pulleys behind you;Let the arms hang back, curl without swinging the elbows forward

name: Cable Concentration Curl
cues: Sit on a utility bench facing the low pulley;Brace the elbow against the inner thigh and curl to the shoulder

name: Cable Spider Curl
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench facing the low pulleys;Arms hang straight down, curl without moving the upper arms

name: Cable Drag Curl
cues: Straight bar on the low pulley, elbows travel back as you curl;Bar stays in contact with the body

name: Cable Incline Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Sit on an incline bench facing away from the low pulley;Elbows stay pointing up as you extend overhead

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (Reverse Grip)
cues: Pulley high, underhand grip on the bar;Elbows stay at the sides as you press down

name: Cable Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Lie on a flat bench between the low pulleys, V handle or two D handles close together;Press up with the elbows tucked

name: Cable Squeeze Press
cues: Lie on a flat bench between the low pulleys, handles squeezed together at the chest;Press out and keep squeezing

name: Cable Cuban Press
cues: Low pulleys, strap handles, elbows at shoulder height;Rotate the forearms up, then press overhead

name: Cable W Raise
cues: Low pulleys, elbows bent and tucked;Rotate and raise the hands out and up in a W shape

name: Cable Seated Shoulder Press
cues: Sit upright on a utility or upright adjustable bench between the low pulleys;Press the handles overhead without arching the back

name: Cable Standing Shoulder Press
cues: Pulleys low, handles at the shoulders, staggered stance;Press overhead and keep ribs down

name: Incline Bench Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench facing the cable stacks, handles crossed;Open the arms wide in a reverse fly

name: Chest-Supported Cable Row (Incline Bench)
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench facing the low pulleys;Row the handles toward the hips with elbows tucked

name: Standing Cable Crunch
cues: Pulley high with a straight bar or strap handles at the forehead;Round the spine down, ribs toward the pelvis

name: Lying Cable Crunch
cues: Lie on a yoga mat facing away from a low pulley, strap handles at the head;Crunch ribs to pelvis and lower slowly

name: Cable Oblique Crunch
cues: Kneel side-on to a high pulley, handle by the ear;Crunch sideways, ribs toward the hip

name: Stability Ball Cable Crunch
cues: Sit on a stability ball facing away from the high pulley, strap handles at the head;Round the spine forward and down

name: Stability Ball Cable Chest Fly
cues: Lie with the upper back on a stability ball between the low pulleys;Bring handles together over the chest with soft elbows
